notes.title: Iwakura Aria is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Iwakura Aria is OUT NOW![/h2][p][/p][p]The year is 1966. It was the last Sunday in June, a blisteringly hot day and everything was about to change. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/3dfcf0d02b3fdf2a329605da150cdbf0554e29e5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Ichiko Kitagawa, a young orphan with a love for drawing, had just stepped foot into her future home, the grand Iwakura estate on the outskirts of Tokyo. Lifted from the streets and offered a new life as a maid, Ichiko enters a world that would alter the course of her life forever.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/1893b15b6a4e2932e170466212efc562a3ef43bc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Iwakura Aria invites you to explore the elegant yet unsettling rooms of the Iwakura mansion. The story unfolds within these walls, and the mansion is open for you to explore. Returning to familiar rooms may reveal new details or hidden truths waiting to be uncovered.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/ceac9cd3437a09f654459b60252944f3dde941c3.jpg"][/img]
At the center of this story is Aria Iwakura, the beautiful daughter of the household. Aria is cold and fragile, but she soon melts in the presence of Ichiko. Their relationship, delicate and slow-burning, evolves with each passing day. Despite their different roles within the mansion, the two share a quiet bond over art, both finding comfort in creativity and moments of peace. For Aria, who spends her days entertaining guests and living under the weight of the Iwakura name, Ichiko’s presence is something rare.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/8269f48dcafbf00bbe35f35d5696b3f5be018c8c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But not all is as it seems in the Iwakura mansion.[/p][p]As Ichiko’s bond with Aria deepens, she soon finds herself unraveling not just the secrets of the mansion, but the hidden lives of those within it. The truths she uncovers will change everything.[/p][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="ZhhaUrTpR-s;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Iwakura Aria is in Next Fest!
notes.content: [h3][b]Next Fest is here, and Iwakura Aria is part of it![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Try Iwakura Aria for the first time. The Trial version features three areas of the story that you can explore: [/p][p]🏰 [b]The Iwakura Mansion[/b][/p][p][b]🫀 Her Body[/b][/p][p][b]👭 Aria and Ichiko[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Play through each part and get a feel for the atmosphere, characters, and the deeper story that awaits.[/p][p]Iwakura Aria is a moving visual novel that follows the deepening connection between Ichiko and Aria. As you progress, tension builds and unsettling truths begin to surface. Not everything is as it seems and what looks harmless might not be.[/p][p]You’ll play as Ichiko, experiencing life within the Iwakura Mansion. But Aria isn’t just along for the ride she begins to grow with you. The story weaves your connection tighter, revealing more about her and the others who live in the mansion.[/p][p]Play each part of the Iwakura Aria Trial version now and uncover different layers of the narrative!🕯️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/6d93da7b9c7b1353bb54a13965846eca3f60dd7f.jpg"][/img][/p]
